# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_racial_heritage.py". Change racial_heritage_data.py and re-run.
# Racial Heritage (doc 44): which race a country is, and which of its former races still live in it.
#   DA_RH_race.<race>   country flag: the race of the primary culture, cached by DA_RH_refresh
#   DA_RH_had.<race>    the country has been of this race since its first refresh
#   DA_RH_kept.<race>   a former race that is kept: the grace period, or its people (DA_RH_test_kept)
#   DA_RH_init          the race has been read once; before that (an old save) the triggers read it live
#   DA_RH_changed_race  the country has changed race: only such countries test their former races
#   DA_RH_grace         set again at every change of race; the grace lasts 3650 days

# ---- The country's race (its primary heritage), from the cache; live before the first refresh ----
DA_RH_primary_centaur = {
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = DA_RH_race.centaur
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_init }
			DA_RH_is_centaur = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- Kept or dormant (doc 44, section 4.4, rules 2 and 8) ----
# The grace period: 3650 days after the last change of race, or while Anbennar's restructuring lasts.
DA_RH_in_grace = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_grace
			NOT = { had_country_flag = { flag = DA_RH_grace days = 3650 } }
		}
		has_country_modifier = restructuring_administration
	}
}
# A former race is kept in the grace period, or while its people pass the test of the random research events.
DA_RH_keeps_centaur = {
	OR = {
		DA_RH_in_grace = yes

	}

# ---- What the windows ask ----
# The race tab of Projects & Research opens: the country's race has a page.
DA_RH_has_page = {
	OR = {
		DA_RH_primary_dwarven = yes
		DA_RH_primary_elven = yes
		DA_RH_primary_ruinborn = yes
		DA_RH_primary_gnomish = yes
		DA_RH_primary_goblin = yes
		DA_RH_primary_kobold = yes
		DA_RH_primary_lizardfolk = yes
	}
}
# The top-bar button opens the hub: a built hall belongs to an active heritage of the country.
DA_RH_has_hall = {
	OR = {
		DA_RH_hall_ours_dwarven = yes
		DA_RH_hall_ours_elven = yes
		DA_RH_hall_ours_goblin = yes
		DA_RH_hall_ours_kobold = yes
		DA_RH_hall_ours_gnomish = yes
		DA_RH_hall_ours_lizardfolk = yes
	}
}

# The hub or a built hall is open (the top-bar button then closes it).
DA_RH_window_open = {
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = DA_RH_hub_on
		DA_has_wonders_etc_interface_open = yes
		has_country_flag = DA_EL_archive_on
		has_country_flag = DA_GB_boomworks_on
		has_country_flag = DA_KB_forge_on
		has_country_flag = DA_GN_workshop_on
		has_country_flag = DA_LZ_hall_on
	}
}
# A monstrous nation (Anbennar's monstrous_nation).
DA_RH_monstrous = {
	has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
